_doc: Creep camps of L_Island (test level, 400 m island). Same shape as mapa_ue.json 'acampamentos': cm, z is only a hint (ue_creeps_camp.py drops the camp onto the ground). The first small camp is 18 m west of the plaza PlayerStart; the others came from ue_l_island_011.py ACT='clareiras' (flat, 8 m clear of anything with collision, 60 m apart) on 2026-10-15. Medium camps (Puglin) sit at the east and west ends, away from the start.
